links.outcome: Correct triage of case vignettes including emergencies by GPT-3 versus physicians and lay people
links.effect: GPT-3 triaged 71% correct (95% CI, 57% to 82%), similar to lay individuals (74%) and significantly worse than physicians (91%; p<0.001).
links.quote: GPT-3 triaged (71% correct; 95% CI, 57% to 82%) similarly to lay individuals (74%; 95% CI, 73% to 75%; p=0.73); both were significantly worse than physicians (91%; 95% CI, 89% to 93%; p<0.001).

links.outcome: GPT-3 diagnostic and triage accuracy compared with physicians and lay adults on the same vignettes
links.effect: Top-3 diagnosis: GPT-3 88% vs lay 54% (p<0.001) and physicians 96% (p=0.0354). Triage: GPT-3 71% vs lay 74% (p=0.73) and physicians 91% (p<0.001).
links.quote: Among all cases, GPT-3 replied with the correct diagnosis in its top 3 for 88% (95% CI, 75% to 94%) of cases, compared to 54% (95% CI, 53% to 55%) for lay individuals (p<0.001) and 96% (95% CI, 94% to 97%) for physicians (p=0.0354).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of GPT-3's diagnostic and triage accuracy compared to laypeople and physicians using clinical case vignettes.
